content:
LENA VARGA-HOLM
Senior Data Engineer | Data Platform
Rijeka, Croatia | lena.vargaholm@example.com | +385 55 555 0101 | github.com/lvh-data-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior Data Engineer with 9 years of experience designing, building and operating production data platforms and cloud data warehouses across logistics, e-commerce and payments. Experienced with Python, SQL, Airflow, dbt, Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, Redshift and AWS. Proven record improving pipeline reliability and performance, establishing data contracts and quality checks, and building reusable data tools for multiple teams. MSc in Computer Science; professional English (C1).

CORE SKILLS
Languages: Python, SQL, Bash
Data platforms and engineering: Airflow, dbt, Spark (PySpark), Kafka, Kafka Connect, Snowflake, Redshift, PostgreSQL, Great Expectations
Cloud and infrastructure: AWS (S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, IAM), Docker, Terraform (basic), GitHub Actions
Data modeling and BI: Dimensional modeling, star schemas, Power BI, Looker (basic)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Data Engineer | Lukovac Freight Hub d.o.o. (logistics marketplace), Rijeka
03/2022 – Present
- Own the ingestion layer of the data platform, operating approximately 140 Airflow DAGs that load data from PostgreSQL, MySQL, Salesforce and third-party APIs into Snowflake.
- Migrated transformation logic from stored procedures to dbt, delivering 420+ models with tests on every model and reducing nightly runtime from 5 hours 10 minutes to 1 hour 35 minutes.
- Introduced JSON Schema data contracts between product teams and data engineering, enforced through CI checks; reduced broken-pipeline incidents from approximately 9 to 2 per month.
- Built a Kafka-based event pipeline using Kafka Connect and Snowpipe Streaming to process approximately 30 million shipment-tracking events per day.
- Mentor two mid-level data engineers and lead weekly data platform office hours.

Data Engineer | Kovalent Pay (payments startup), Zagreb
09/2019 – 02/2022
- Built PySpark jobs on AWS EMR for transaction reconciliation, processing approximately 1.2 TB of raw files from S3 daily.
- Designed a Redshift warehouse schema with 30+ fact and dimension tables, used by finance and risk teams.
- Implemented Great Expectations data quality checks for critical finance tables.
- Developed an internal Python library for S3 and Glue Catalog access, adopted by four teams.

Junior Data Engineer / BI Developer | Adria Retail Group, Split
06/2017 – 08/2019
- Maintained SSIS packages and T-SQL ETL pipelines for an on-premises SQL Server warehouse.
- Built Power BI reports supporting store operations across 40+ stores.
- Migrated 60 nightly SSIS jobs to Python scripts scheduled with cron.

EDUCATION
MSc Computer Science (Data Science track) | Northgate Technical University, 2017
Thesis: Incremental materialized views for analytical queries

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) | English (C1) | German (B1)

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, credible senior-level CV with a clear structure, concise bullets, relevant technical scope, and excellent use of measurable outcomes. It communicates ownership of a production data platform, large-scale processing, reliability improvements, mentoring, and cross-team enablement. The progression from Junior Data Engineer / BI Developer to Senior Data Engineer is clear. The main content opportunity is to make query-performance optimization, data modelling terminology, governance, and reusable-platform work slightly more explicit for this particular role. No unsupported skills or experiences were detected when cross-referenced with the Original Candidate Information.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: ATS compatibility is very good: the CV uses conventional section headings, readable text, standard date formats, keyword-rich skills, and no tables, graphics, columns, or unusual formatting that would likely interfere with parsing. It includes strong matches for Python, SQL, Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI, data quality, Kafka, Snowflake, Redshift, AWS, dimensional modelling, and production data platforms. AI screening probability is high because the document presents relevant seniority, scale, cloud experience, and quantified results. Minor keyword opportunities include explicitly using the job-ad terms “query optimisation,” “data modelling,” “production data platform,” “data quality standards,” and “reusable frameworks,” but only in ways supported by the candidate’s evidence.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The CV aligns very well with the central role: it shows design, build, and operation of a production data platform; cloud warehouse experience at scale; Python and SQL; Airflow and dbt; Docker and CI checks; dimensional/star-schema modelling; data quality controls; and professional English. AWS is a credible comparable cloud experience to the requested Google Cloud, with S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, IAM, Snowflake, and Redshift demonstrating managed storage, processing, orchestration-related infrastructure, and cloud warehouses. The candidate also aligns with the company’s Ownership and Together signals through platform ownership, incident reduction, mentoring, office hours, and tools adopted by multiple teams. The CV does not provide evidence of curiosity about new data architecture ideas or open-source practices, graph modelling, or Portuguese; these are candidate-background gaps rather than document defects. Access-policy ownership and direct collaboration with data scientists are also not demonstrated in the supplied candidate information.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR ATS/JOB-ALIGNMENT ENHANCEMENT 1 — In the Professional Summary, revise the sentence beginning “Experienced with Python, SQL...” to include the supported performance and platform terms. For example: “Experienced with Python and SQL for production data platforms, large-scale data processing and query-performance improvements, using Airflow, dbt, Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, Redshift and AWS.” This foregrounds the existing 1.2 TB processing, 30 million events/day, and runtime-reduction evidence without claiming unsubstantiated direct query-tuning work.

MINOR ATS/JOB-ALIGNMENT ENHANCEMENT 2 — In the Core Skills section, change “Data modeling and BI” to “Data modelling and BI” and write “Dimensional modelling / modeling, star schemas” to capture both the job ad’s spelling and the common ATS variant. Keep this limited to the candidate-supported modelling experience.

MINOR CONTENT ENHANCEMENT 3 — In the Senior Data Engineer role at Lukovac Freight Hub, revise the dbt bullet to make the reusable-platform outcome more explicit while preserving the existing facts. For example: “Migrated transformation logic from stored procedures to dbt, delivering 420+ tested models as reusable transformation assets and reducing nightly runtime from 5 hours 10 minutes to 1 hour 35 minutes.” Only use “reusable transformation assets” if that accurately reflects how the models were used; otherwise retain the current wording.
